boundary.startingEvent: A sighted, non-hallucinating hero whose current room string names a generated shop steps onto one or two-to-four top-level floor objects in that shop's strict interior while its peaceful unsurcharged resident keeper remains in the shop.
boundary.endingEvent: The priced single-object message or priced pile window is displayed, each positive per-unit quote is recorded, the display is dismissed, and the game reaches the next command prompt.
boundary.validInputs: Autopickup disabled; ordinary top-level non-container floor merchandise; generated strict-interior shop square; current-shop equality; present peaceful generated keeper; ordinary quantity pricing; supported object-name and getprice branches; pile_limit count paths that do not name objects.
boundary.observables: Hero movement and room state, object discovery, exact for-sale suffix and currency plurality, menu geometry, price-quote min/max fields, object and floor chains, messages, screens and cursors, PRNG log, and next prompt.
boundary.exclusions: Coins, punishment objects, non-floor or contained objects, other/shared/boundary shops, keeper freespot, no-charge or unpaid objects, absent/displaced/angry/surcharged keepers, containers or contents, globs, artifacts, corpse/tin/egg adjustment, unidentified glass-gem pseudopricing, Dunce cap, young Tourist or visible undershirt adjustment, restore/suppress-price mode, remembered-price display fallback, hallucinated currency, and existing unsupported naming branches.
